items.title: IKEA targets 4x revenue growth in India by 2030
items.summary: The observation comes as the retailer plans to quadruple its revenue in India by 2030, expand its store network to 30 from the current eight and double its investments to Rs 21,000 crore. IKEA, which is recording double-digit sales growth in India, expects to become profitable by 2027-28 if global conditions stabilise, IKEA India CEO Patrik Antoni said.

He, however, stressed on sustained focus on infrastructure development, skilling and cost competitiveness for India to further enhance its manufacturing footprint on a global scale.

items.title: Cos' body for higher duty on copper used in solar module
items.summary: The Indian Primary Copper Producers Association has urged the government to raise customs duties on solar copper products. They recommend increasing the duty on solar PV ribbon and busbars from 5% to 10%. The association also requests maintaining existing duties on refined copper and copper pipes. Domestic production is underutilized due to imports from China affecting the market.

items.title: Wheat sowing faces heat from water shortage this winter
items.summary: Farmers in India are likely to reduce wheat planting this winter due to water scarcity and low minimum support prices. Regions such as Rajasthan, Gujarat, and Madhya Pradesh may see the most significant impact from these conditions. The state governments are encouraging farmers to consider crops that require less water, which may lead to a shift in crop choices.

items.summary: The regulator has also started inspections of dark stores of quick commerce firms and cloud kitchens, he said. The government has been examining complaints accusing quick commerce platforms such as Blinkit, Zepto and Swiggy Instamart of failing to display product information, including expiry, best-before and use-by dates.

items.title: Protests, traffic curbs in Delhi hit hotel business
items.summary: Protests in Delhi are causing significant disruptions, leading to a notable decline in hotel occupancies across the city. Companies have chosen to cancel events and meetings to avoid travel difficulties amid ongoing unrest. Many hotels report F&B sales dropping significantly because of reduced guest activity and restricted access. Some firms have advised their employees to work from home due to traffic curbs and security measures.

items.title: Gold price surge boosts diamond jewellery sales 15-20%

Jewellers are using 18-carat, 14-carat and 9-carat gold to make diamond jewellery more accessible, allowing shoppers to buy lighter pieces without compromising on design.

items.title: Assocham seeks review of bidders' qualificationfor transmission units
items.summary: Assocham has suggested that the ministry improve technical qualification requirements for companies involved in transmission projects. This proposal aims to ensure that only experienced developers participate in the bidding process. The current framework allows companies to qualify based on broad infrastructure experience, which may delay project execution. The association recommends that qualifications be tailored to project value, voltage class, and complexity.

items.title: Cleveland Fed's Hammack backs restrictive policy, says better if it comes 'relatively quickly'
